messages:
jenny: quick proposal — add a visible credential badge on request traces showing the effective credential (org-key / project-key / service-account) and a short routing reason. thinking this will help debug billing misattribution and quota surprises :thinking:
li: love that. is the plan to show the badge only in the console trace view or surface it in the route detail API too?
sam: +1. prefer both — console for humans, route detail API header for infra/alerts. header could be `X-Redwood-Credential: project:12345` or `org:6789`
ajex: careful with leaking org ids in logs visible to users — should be id-hashed or short form. we already mask some PII.
maria: for telemetry we should add fields: `effective_credential_type`, `effective_credential_id_hash`, `route_reason` (pinned|quota-fallback|region-fallback|manual). then dashboards can break down latency/errors by credential type.
jenny: agree. proposed rollout: feature-flag `delegation_badge_v1`. start canary at 1% of traffic for 48h, collect: 429 rate by credential, 5xxs, p95 latency, billing attribution mismatch rate.
pat: who owns the dashboard? I'd suggest infra-apps builds a dedicated panel under the existing auth dashboard. need to avoid creating one-off queries all over.
li: I can add a panel but need the telemetry schema ASAP. also: we should tag whether credential was inferred vs explicitly provided. to disambiguate SAs used by exchange flows.
sam: good call. add `credential_source` = explicit|exchange|fallback. exchange means token swap path used.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary flag `delegation_badge_v1` enabled on prod-canary-1 at 2024-05-02T17:22:31Z :white_check_mark:
jenny: FYI — edge case: some customers use projectless keys. Dashboard should group projectless under `projectless` to avoid null buckets.
alex: UX note: console badge should be clickable and show a small flyout with raw header, last-rotate time, and a quick link to 'reassign to project' in case customer wants to rebind. keep it compact.
maria: also capture `credential_ttl_remaining_s` in telemetry (helps identify stale ephemeral tokens causing falls-to-fallback).
pat: can we also record `route_decision_chain` as an ordered short list like `pinned->quota_trigger->region` (as a string) so we can replay why we fell back? 
jenny: yes, but keep it short, maybe 3 elements max. store as `->` delimited string.
li: implementation note: runtime will annotate requests at the router hop with these telemetry keys before hitting the ingest pipeline. patching the runtime to include `cred_type` + `cred_hash` is ~1day.
sam: devapi change: new header `X-Redwood-Route-Trace: cred=project:abc123;reason=pinned` — simple keyvals. add to docs.
ajex: make sure we don't break existing clients that rely on unknown headers — header should be additive and optional.
ops-bot: metrics: created new metric `redwood.request.credential_type.p95_latency` and `redwood.request.credential_source.429_rate`. panels auto-populated for prod, prod-canary.
jenny: canary results after 48h — share summary here. if 429/5xx delta < 0.1% and no customer support noise, ramp to 10% then 50% with automated rollback on jitter.
maria: also add a regression eval: run our eval prompts through routes that changed to ensure no quality-drop due to fallback routing. link: https://internal.evals/reports/delegation-badge-v1
pat: small privacy check: legal asked we add an allowlist for showing org display names in console. default shows hashed id, allowlist shows human name.
li: noted — will add `show_org_names` flag in console feature gating.
sam: docs todo: API header docs + console screenshots + migration notes for customers who parse logs. I'll draft a PR.
jenny: OK folks — action items: li telemetry schema + hash strategy, sam header + docs PR, maria dashboard + eval link, pat privacy gating. re-check in 3 days or when canary data is in. :rocket:
